match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: She stops mid-motion and listens to the street. Framing: wide, eye level, Handheld observational view of the bakery entrance and street; MARA is framed by the doorway, with the opposite side of the road visible. Placement only, not the pose: MARA stands at the bakery entrance beside the shop sign, ready to turn it; CYCLIST is not yet in frame. Camera, as one or two arrows: handheld follow, natural, lightly responsive. Characters: CYCLIST, Unspecified, 20s–40s, A delivery cyclist seen across the road, A practical dark cycling jacket, fitted trousers. MARA, Female, 30s, A woman in her 30s, of average height, A white cotton baker’s shirt, a flour-dusted natural-canvas. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
